title: Daisy Meets the Sea Lion! 🌊 Ocean Adventure
description: 🐦 Daisy the bluebird is flying over the big, blue ocean today! 🌊 He meets a wonderful sea lion named Splash who lives by the sea! 🦭 Together they learn about the amazing ocean and what it means to be a great friend!
thumbnail_prompt: Cartoon bluebird named Daisy wearing a tiny red scarf standing on a sunny ocean rock next to a friendly smiling sea lion, bright blue ocean waves and splashing water in the background, vibrant colors, cute and cheerful art style for kids, sunny sky with fluffy white clouds

scenes.narration: Wings up, friends! Today I am flying somewhere VERY big and VERY blue! Can YOU guess where I am going? I think I hear waves!
scenes.visual_description: Daisy the small bluebird swoops into frame wearing his tiny red scarf, doing a big looping swoop across a bright blue sky. A burst of sparkly blue and white colors explodes behind him. He cups his wing to his ear as if listening. Camera zooms toward a glittering ocean horizon.

scenes.narration: Whoa! Look at ALL that water! This is the OCEAN! The ocean is huge! The ocean is deep! The ocean is SO full of life! I can hear the waves — SPLASH, SPLASH, SPLASH! The ocean is salty and cool and wonderful!
scenes.visual_description: Daisy lands on a large sunny rock near the shoreline. The camera pans wide to show a vast shimmering blue-green ocean stretching to the horizon. Sunlight sparkles on the water. White waves crash gently on rocks. Seagulls float in the background. Daisy spins around with big wide eyes and open wings, totally amazed.

scenes.narration: Hmm. What is THAT big splash?! Oh my goodness! Hello there! Who are YOU? Hi friends, this is SPLASH the Sea Lion! Sea lions live right here by the ocean! Splash, what is it like living here? Oh WOW, I want to know everything!
scenes.visual_description: A big friendly sea lion bursts out of the water near Daisy's rock, landing with a happy SPLASH and shaking water droplets everywhere. The sea lion has big warm brown eyes and a wide goofy smile. Daisy jumps back in surprise then laughs with delight. The sea lion claps its flippers together and barks happily. Daisy leans forward with giant curious eyes, red scarf fluttering.

scenes.narration: Splash says sea lions are AMAZING swimmers! They use their flippers to swim super fast! Flippers are like arms that help you zoom through water! Watch Splash go! ZOOM! Sea lions can hold their breath underwater too! They dive down deep to find yummy fish! Daisy tries to hold his breath. One… two… three! WOW! And sea lions love to rest on sunny rocks — just like this one! The warm sun keeps them cozy! Can YOU find a sunny spot to rest? That is what sea lions do!
scenes.visual_description: Scene 1: Splash dives back into the water and zooms in circles, flippers paddling fast. Animated speed lines and bubbles trail behind. Daisy watches from the rock with his beak dropped open. Scene 2: Splash pops underwater and catches a shiny fish, then leaps back up triumphantly. Daisy puffs up his little chest and holds his breath, cheeks puffed, counting on his wing feathers. Scene 3: Splash hauls out onto the warm flat rock beside Daisy and stretches out in the sunlight with a big happy sigh. Both Daisy and Splash lie side by side soaking up the sun. A small animated sun icon appears with the word WARM next to it.
sound_effects: Daisy counting sound one two three

scenes.narration: Oh no! Look! Daisy's little red scarf blew off in the wind! It is floating out on the water! The scarf is going far away! Oh no, oh no! But wait — Splash can help! Sea lions are amazing swimmers, remember? Splash dives in FAST! Splash swims with those strong flippers — ZOOM! Splash grabs the scarf and brings it back! Hooray! Thank you Splash! You used your flippers to save the day!
scenes.visual_description: A gust of animated wind swoops across the rock and blows Daisy's tiny red scarf off his neck. It tumbles through the air and lands on the water, floating away on a gentle wave. Daisy flaps his wings in a panic, looking upset. Splash sees the scarf, looks determined, and leaps into the water with a heroic splash. Underwater view shows Splash zooming with powerful flipper strokes toward the scarf. Splash grabs it gently in his mouth and rockets back to the surface, sliding up onto the rock and presenting the scarf to Daisy. Daisy ties it back on and hugs Splash happily. Confetti and stars burst around them.

scenes.narration: Wow friends, we learned SO much today! The ocean is a big, beautiful home! Sea lions swim with their flippers — ZOOM! They hold their breath to find fish! And they rest on sunny rocks to stay warm! Splash helped Daisy with those amazing flippers! Friends help friends! Every home is special. And every friend has something amazing to share!
scenes.visual_description: Daisy stands on the rock with Splash beside him. Soft glowing icons pop up one by one as each fact is repeated: a flipper, a fish, a sunny rock. Daisy points to each one with his wing. Splash claps his flippers together proudly. The ocean glimmers behind them. Both characters turn to face the viewer with big warm smiles. A soft golden light glows around them.
sound_effects: soft chime for each fact pop-up

scenes.narration: Goodbye Splash! You are the BEST ocean friend! Wings up, friends! If you love animals and adventures, hit that subscribe button! We go somewhere NEW every time! And next time — I am flying somewhere VERY cold and VERY snowy! Brrr! Where do YOU think I am going? Tell me in the comments! Bye bye friends! Wings up!
scenes.visual_description: Daisy gives Splash a big wing-hug. Splash barks happily and waves a flipper. Daisy leaps into the air and soars upward with a spiraling swoop, red scarf streaming behind him. He turns back and waves his wing at the viewer. A subscribe button animation bounces in the corner. The ocean sparkles below as Daisy flies off into the bright blue sky toward the horizon. The screen fades with a sparkle wipe. The last image is Daisy silhouetted against a big orange sunset.

facts_taught: Sea lions use their strong flippers to swim very fast through the ocean
Sea lions can hold their breath and dive underwater to catch fish
Sea lions rest on warm sunny rocks to keep their bodies warm
moral: Every friend has special gifts to share, and helping each other makes every adventure better.
next_episode_tease: Next time Daisy flies somewhere VERY cold and covered in snow — bundle up for the Arctic tundra!
